title: Design and optimization of tamarind seed polysaccharide-based scaffold for tissue engineering applications using statistical modeling and machine learning, and it's in-vitro validation.
summary: The optimized polysaccharide scaffold was mechanically tested and showed cytocompatibility; ANN contribution is shared with statistical optimization, and tissue regeneration was not demonstrated.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network, compared with response-surface modeling
